name: Usage Receipts
description: Every LLM invocation produces a usage receipt containing: tokens in (prompt), tokens out (completion), cost, provider, model, latency (TTFT and total), cache hit/miss, model version, request ID, start/end timestamps. Receipts are emitted as structured events for billing, monitoring, and analytics consumption.
purpose: Provide observability into every LLM invocation — costs, performance, and usage — for billing, capacity planning, and cost attribution purposes.
acceptanceCriteria: Receipt shape includes: requestId, provider, model, modelVersion, promptTokens, completionTokens, cachedTokens, cost, latencyMs (total and ttft), startTime, endTime, streamed, cacheHit
Receipt emitted as an event on a UsageReceiptBus
Receipts can be batched and written to a persistent store
Cost is calculated from usage model by multiplying token counts by per-model prices
Latency split: time-to-first-token (TTFT) and total duration
Cache hit/miss recorded when caching enabled
Zero-cost receipts supported (e.g., for local models)
Receipt stream is observable via EventEmitter or subscriber pattern
